body:
**Defects from the DM-61 end-to-end run.**
1. The runbook says file edits and "anything else" always ask. Claude Code's own auto-memory writes don't ask (see the DM-53 comment). Fix the adapter, or state the exception in the runbook.
2. The runbook says a chat appears "in the app's session list". The app has no session list: the footer and folder page show only a count ("1 agent session · stdio"). Role and label are visible only through MCP `list_sessions` and on run records. Evidence: `17-mcp-connection-one-agent-session.png`.
